execution_requirements: Confirm active network policy allows source host before making an upstream query; do not bypass blocked destinations.
Use a valid source session/API entitlement where required; access to an institutional link is not proof of authentication or search execution.
Capture native query, requested and applied filters, exact timestamp and timezone, database/collection, sort, page size, pages, total source count, exported count and raw-response/export hashes.
If blocked before search, query_executed=false, total_hits=null and retrieved_record_count=null; unavailable does not mean zero.
If accessible, paginate/export all records or declare the exact stopping rule and truncated coverage. Do not sum hit estimates across overlapping queries.

inclusion: Bitcoin/BTC/BTCUSDT or a mixed-asset study with separately extractable Bitcoin results
Volatility or variance forecasting/prediction outcome with market, source, sampling frequency, target formula and forecast horizon identifiable
DL used as an independent comparator, with architecture/protocol and verifiable metrics sufficient for extraction
Identifiable author/title/document and reported or explicitly unknown publication status/year
exclusion_after_screening: Price/direction/trading-only outcomes without a volatility/variance forecast
Only other assets with no separately extractable Bitcoin experiment
No recoverable scientific document sufficient to establish model role/protocol/results; retain as context or pending retrieval rather than inventing evidence
Redundant version of the same work; retain linkage rather than count as a second study
not_automatic_exclusions: A hybrid proposed model if it compares an independently evaluated simple DL model
Unknown year; retain explicitly as exploratory with sensitivity, not as proven recent indexed evidence

deduplication: Normalize DOI: lower-case, strip doi.org URL and surrounding punctuation; exact DOI agreement links records
Normalize arXiv base identifier and preserve v-number separately; connect preprint and final DOI through explicit metadata
Absent DOI/arXiv linkage, compare normalized title, authors and year, then manually review ambiguous pairs
Different datasets or targets in one work are experiments within the study, not additional papers; each study counts at most once per independent comparator family

quality_domains: clarity of target/dataset and temporal availability
seed repetitions and what dispersion represents
quality_and_flow.reviewer_policy: Record actual screener and resolver. Do not claim independent human reviewers, agreement or consensus when not performed.
quality_and_flow.quartile_policy: Verify source index, journal, reporting system (e.g. JCR vs SJR), edition/year and subject category. A DOI, Scopus/WoS hit or IEEE conference record alone does not prove Q1 or peer review.
quality_and_flow.grey_literature_policy: arXiv is a complementary preprint source. Mark peer-review status and link later journal versions; report sensitivities excluding grey documents and unverified-date items.

capture_plan_status: Prepared before the current access attempts; not a retrospective claim about historical searches.
